mintAuthority.summary: MUSD's only canonical native issuance route is on Mezo: BorrowerOperations opens BTC-collateralized troves at a 110% minimum collateral ratio and InterestRateManager mints accrued interest. The Mezo token owner's 5-of-9 Safe administers the canonical mintList and can authorize arbitrary additional Mezo minters, so canonical issuance remains unbounded-or-compromised. Ethereum and Base are Wormhole NTT burning-spoke representations; their bridge minting, burn, rate-limit, upgrade, peer, pause, and Guardian-attestation controls are assessed under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Mezo BorrowerOperations CDP mint route
controls.capDescription: BorrowerOperations mints MUSD only against troves collateralized by BTC at or above the 110% minimum collateral ratio; the InterestRateManager 0x4a453700d157717Fe02fB62E7700ED7845048285 is the second system minter for accrued interest. No separate cap-raising authority exists for this route.
controls.evidence: At Mezo block 11179505 (2026-08-16, https://jsonrpc-mezo.boar.network): mintList(0x44b1bac67dDA612a41a58AAf779143B181dEe031) = true and mintList(InterestRateManager 0x4a453700d157717Fe02fB62E7700ED7845048285) = true on the MUSD token. The pinned MUSD.sol source shows mint() requires mintList[msg.sender] and the Liquity system contracts are the CDP mint route; BorrowerOperations issuance is economically bounded by BTC collateral at the 110% MCR, while the owner-controlled allowlist remains a separate arbitrary-minter surface.

controls.label: Mezo protocol owner Safe (canonical MUSD token owner)
controls.capDescription: The Mezo owner Safe administers the canonical token's mintList/burnList allowlists (addToMintList/addToBurnList are onlyOwner in MUSD.sol), so it can authorize arbitrary new Mezo minters; it does not itself call mint(). The same Safe's Ethereum/Base token and NTT-manager ownership is bridge administration reviewed separately under bridgeRouteRisk.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770834 (2026-08-16), owner() of the MUSD token on Ethereum, Base, and Mezo was 0x98D8899c3030741925BE630C710A98B57F397C7a; its 5-of-9 Safe returned the 9 listed owners. Module pagination returned an empty sentinel list, but getGuard() reverted, so the guard state remains unresolved and is recorded as unknown. On canonical Mezo, onlyOwner addToMintList controls who may mint; Ethereum/Base NTT manager minting and the shared Safe's bridge administration are excluded from native Mint Authority and preserved in bridgeRouteRisk.

review.evidence: 2026-08-16 on-chain review across Mezo, Ethereum, and Base. The same immutable 6,436-byte MUSD deployment at 0xdd468a1ddc392dcdbef6db6e34e89aa338f9f186 on all three chains gates mint() through an owner-administered mintList. Mezo is the only native issuance chain: at block 11179505, BorrowerOperations and InterestRateManager are the verified mintList entries for the BTC-collateralized CDP and accrued-interest paths. Ethereum (block 25770834) and Base (block 50066278) are Wormhole NTT burning-spoke representations: their NTT managers mint only in response to conserved guardian-attested burn messages, and their bridge controls are authored under bridgeRouteRisk rather than native Mint Authority. The token owner on all three chains is the 5-of-9 Safe 0x98D8899c3030741925BE630C710A98B57F397C7a. The Safe can authorize arbitrary additional canonical Mezo minters through onlyOwner addToMintList, so no supply cap or whole-supply reconciliation constrains every possible native mint path; authorityPosture remains unbounded-or-compromised, economicCapSemantics remains unbounded, reconciliation remains unknown, and supervision remains none. Module pagination was empty but getGuard() reverted, so Safe guard status remains unknown. EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots remain zero on the reviewed deployments; MUSD is immutable and has no separate implementation-upgrade path.
